2609.01487.title: Defense-as-Skill: Evolving Runtime Guard Skill for Skill-Augmented Agents
2609.01487.paper_summary: Skill-augmented agents load reusable skills as persistent runtime context, improving task performance but also giving malicious skills a durable channel for steering future actions. Such skills may leak secrets, corrupt code, bypass approvals, or stage data for exfiltration only after a concrete user task and workspace state make the unsafe action appear useful. This makes pre-install vetting insufficient and calls for runtime, task-conditioned protection. We propose Defense-as-Skill, a defense paradigm that implements the runtime guard itself as an installable, inspectable, and editable skill. Our guard, SkillSonar, runs alongside untrusted task skills and checks sensitive actions against the user's task boundary, routing each action to an allow, replan, or confirmation decision without modifying the underlying agent runtime. To study this setting, we construct SCOPE-R, a task-conditioned dataset covering 6 risk families and 21 sub-categories, with 206 attack-confirmed malicious instances and 43 benign tasks. We then improve SkillSonar on the SCOPE-R training subset using runtime guard-skill evolution, a Monte-Carlo Tree Search procedure that evolves the on-disk guard skill from feedback on the rollouts. Across Claude Code and OpenClaw, the evolved guard substantially reduces attack success while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off. On repeated GLM-5 runs, SkillSonar reduces ID ASR from 0.482 to 0.104 and OOD ASR from 0.606 to 0.115. Further analyses demonstrate transfer across victim models, held-out risk families, and external benchmarks, as well as retained protection against adaptive attackers. Ablations further show that explicit safety responsibility assignment and the skill-native representation are both important to the observed gains.
2609.01487.paper_summary_zh: 技能增強代理將可重用技能作為持久的運行時上下文加載，改善任務性能，但也為惡意技能提供了一個持久的渠道來引導未來的行動。這些技能可能會洩漏秘密、損壞代碼、繞過批准，或在具體的用戶任務和工作空間狀態下，將數據準備好以進行外洩，讓不安全的行動看起來有用。這使得預安裝的審核不足，並呼籲運行時、任務條件的保護。我們提出了防禦即技能（Defense-as-Skill），這是一種防禦範式，將運行時保護本身實現為可安裝、可檢查和可編輯的技能。我們的保護，SkillSonar，與不可信的任務技能並行運行，並根據用戶的任務邊界檢查敏感行動，將每個行動路由到允許、重新規劃或確認的決策，而不修改基礎的代理運行時。為了研究這一設定，我們構建了SCOPE-R，一個涵蓋6種風險類別和21個子類別的任務條件數據集，其中包含206個攻擊確認的惡意實例和43個良性任務。然後，我們使用運行時保護技能演化來改善SCOPE-R訓練子集上的SkillSonar，這是一種蒙特卡羅樹搜索程序，根據回滾的反饋演化磁碟上的保護技能。在Claude Code和OpenClaw上，演化的保護大幅減少了攻擊成功率，同時保持了有利的安全-效用權衡。在重複的GLM-5運行中，SkillSonar將ID ASR從0.482降低到0.104，將OOD ASR從0.606降低到0.115。進一步的分析顯示了在受害者模型、保留的風險類別和外部基準之間的轉移，以及對自適應攻擊者的保護保持。消融實驗進一步表明，明確的安全責任分配和技能本地表示對觀察到的增益都很重要。
